procedures.title: Battery voltage test
steps: Set the multimeter to DC volts.
Place the red lead on B+ and the black lead on B-.
Read the voltage with the key OFF.

procedures.title: Starter relay test
steps: Remove starter relay K1 from its socket.
Insert K1 in the relay tester and press TEST.
Read the PASS or FAIL lamp on the tester.

procedures.title: Belt condition check
steps: Press the belt midway between the pulleys.
Look for cracks, fraying or missing pieces.

procedures.title: Battery replacement
steps: Disconnect the negative cable first, then the positive cable.
Remove the hold-down clamp and lift out the battery.
Tighten the terminal nuts to 6 N.m. Coat the terminals with terminal grease.
Record the date code of the new battery.

guards.text: Stop the pump and remove the start key or lock out the supply before you open any cover. Rotating parts can cause serious injury.
Batteries give off explosive gas. Keep sparks and flames away from the battery.
Do not let the meter leads touch each other or the frame while they are on the battery terminals.
guards.guards: step:Place the red lead on B+ and the black lead on B-.

guards.text: A battery that was just charged reads high for about an hour. Wait before you test it.
guards.guards: step:Read the voltage with the key OFF.

guards.text: Do not bridge relay terminals with a bare wire. Use the relay tester only.
guards.guards: step:Insert K1 in the relay tester and press TEST.

guards.text: Do not open the radiator cap while the engine is hot. Hot coolant can cause burns.
Lock out the electrical supply before you open the motor terminal box.
Stop the pump before you touch the belt. The fan can cut fingers.
A tight belt moves no more than 15 mm when pressed.
guards.guards: step:Press the belt midway between the pulleys.

guards.text: Disconnect the negative cable first to prevent a short circuit.
guards.guards: step:Disconnect the negative cable first, then the positive cable.

guards.text: The battery weighs 28 kg. Use two people and the lifting strap to lift it.
guards.guards: step:Remove the hold-down clamp and lift out the battery.
